questions.prompt: Hi! Welcome to the club. Where do you like to visit?
questions.sample_answer: If I have a chance, I'd like to visit Da Lat. Da Lat is famous for its cool weather, various types of flowers, and romantic scenes. When visiting Da Lat, I will go to its pine forests, flowers garden, vintage houses, and stores,

questions.prompt: Hi! Why did you decide to join the club?
questions.sample_answer: Hi! I joined the nature club because I love spending time outdoors and want to learn more about protecting the environment. It’s also a great way to meet others who share my passion.

questions.prompt: The bigger the club, the more environmentally conscious people are, right?
questions.sample_answer: Yes, that's true! A bigger club means more people learning about nature and taking action to protect the environment. Together, we can make a bigger impact and inspire others to care for our planet.
